title: Clay
look: Plasticine: round soft highlights, a contact shadow, stop-motion at 8 fps.

doc.essence: A stop-motion puppet in plasticine: lit from the top left, every frame posed by hand.
doc.notIt: Not soft-gradient (radial light, contact shadow, stop-motion).
doc.shapes: No outline; a soft offset contact shadow. A chunky, squat puppet: blobby corners, short thick limbs, mitten hands.
doc.colour: Radial highlight to a darker rim.
doc.eyes: Small glossy beads with a shine.
doc.motion: 8 fps with a tiny wobble and a little overshoot.
pitfalls: Fast actions look jerky at 8 fps on purpose.
